description: Graph serialization and insertion, clipboard cache transport, workflow and legacy conversion, and browser copy/paste routing. Feature callers retain history, feedback, and persistence.

characterizationScenarios.name: Graph transfer preserves identities, links, subgraphs, selection, lifecycle, and rollback through extension-compatible canvas methods
Cache refusal preserves system copy while in-memory duplication leaves the clipboard unchanged
Browser copy and paste arbitrate editable targets and keep clipboard data alive across asynchronous work
Workflow and legacy imports preserve links, widget values, and selection order

compatibilityPromises: Extension-facing canvas clipboard methods retain their return values, lifecycle hooks, layout commands, and insertion behavior.
Clipboard keys and modern and legacy payload formats remain compatible with earlier frontend versions.
In-memory graph transfer does not read, overwrite, or restore the browser clipboard cache.
